text:
elaine (pm): Quick sync: sketched an "onramp-lite" for routing + multi-region pilots. Need agreement on scope and launch gates. Link: https://redwood.share/routing-onramp-lite

samir (arch): Proposal: three pilot modes — 1) soft-affinity (preferred region, global fallback), 2) hard-affinity (route pinned, no fallback), 3) hybrid (pin payments, soft for others). Each has different infra and telemetry needs.

miguel (eng): Tech constraints: hard-affinity forces node labeling and reduces bin-packing; expects reserve capacity. We'll surface delta estimates once product lists pilots.

nina (sre): Ops checklist for pilots: canary % = 5-10, stability window = 30m, p95 latency no more than 2x baseline, fallback alerts if triggered >1/min. Also need synthetic probes per-region to validate routing.

marcus (sales): Customers expect audit trails for routing decisions. Ask: minimal audit event should include policy_id, matched_route, chosen_region, fallback_reason. Can sales get a template for contract language?

samir (arch): DSL example for product to review:
```
policy: payments_eu {
  match: customer=="FinCo" && route=="payments"
  isolation: hard
  regions: [eu-west-1]
  fallback: allowed=false
}
```

miguel (eng): Also need defaults for autoscale: min_reserved=1, max_burst=2x, eviction_window=5m. Product pick or we choose conservative defaults (costly).

elaine (pm): Draft launch gates: 99.5% regional success over 24h, cost cap per-tenant for pilot, KMS in-region for residency, documented rollback steps. Action: product owners add pilot rows by Mon EOD.

policy-bot: policy-telemetry proxy deployment queued (staging).

elaine (pm): OK if we lock two pilots Wed? We'll use BetaLabs as low-risk test and either FinCo or Acme depending on revenue/complexity matrix.

nina (sre): I'll prepare runbook and alerting thresholds.

miguel (eng): I'll produce sizing delta for hard vs soft affinity for the three pilots (Tue).

samir (arch): One more: telemetry must emit policy_hit and fallback events so Console can show econ impact per policy. Product: include a plain-language policy summary for contracts.

elaine (pm): thanks all — see matrix draft and add rows.
